Rebuild both CROBOT sidebars to match Linear exactly. Work from the approved plan at /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/lets-migrate-local-supabase-melodic-goblet.md — read it first, it has the full context, current-state map, and 6-phase approach.

## Project
- Path: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT`
- Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, pnpm 9.15.4
- NO `any`, NO `as any`, NO `@ts-ignore`
- NO new dependencies

## Critical files to change
1. `app/globals.css` — ADD 2 tokens: `--sidebar-item-active-bg`, `--sidebar-item-hover-bg` (light + dark mode each). Put them alongside the existing `--sidebar-*` block. Do NOT modify other tokens.
2. `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` — full rewrite per plan Phase 2
3. `components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` — rewrite the sidebar section ONLY (lines ~140–220). Do NOT touch the top-bar / breadcrumb logic outside the sidebar.
4. `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — ONLY edit the `SidebarTrigger` component (~line 219). Wrap the 28×28 button with a 44×44 mobile hit area using `after:absolute after:-inset-2 after:md:hidden` (pattern already used elsewhere in same file near line 493).

## Key requirements (from plan — don't deviate)

### User sidebar (AppSidebar.tsx)
**4 labeled groups**:
- **Workspace** — Dashboard, New Scan
- **Analyze** — My Reports, Score History, Competitors
- **Manage** — Integrations, Monitoring
- **Account** — Refer & Earn, API, Settings

**Active state**: kill the `before:` left-border pill entirely. Use `bg-[--sidebar-item-active-bg] text-[--sidebar-foreground-active]` only. Linear has no left accent — just a subtle background shift.

**Hover state**: `hover:bg-[--sidebar-item-hover-bg]`, 150ms transition.

**Footer card** (single bordered card, not separator + floating button):
```
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ [plan] Growth    12/25 scans│
│ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░░░                │
│ [Upgrade Plan]               │
└─────────────────────────────┘
```
- Plan label: `text-xs font-medium text-sidebar-foreground` (NOT `text-2xs` or `/40`)
- Scan count right-aligned, same size + color
- Progress bar: `h-1` (Linear-tight)
- Upgrade button: full-width, primary style. Hide entirely if plan is "agency" or unlimited.
- Collapsed mode: replace card with a single 40×40 icon pill (lucide `Sparkles` or `Zap`) that tooltips "Growth · 12/25"

**⌘K hint row** below footer card (only when expanded):
- Small pill: `<button>` with text "Search…" left-aligned, `⌘K` right-aligned
- Style: muted bg, `text-sidebar-foreground/70`, `text-xs`, `h-8`, `rounded-md`
- On click: dispatch a custom event `window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', metaKey: true }))` OR directly import and call a toggle function from `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` (check how it's wired — if it exposes a context hook, use that; otherwise the keydown dispatch works since cmdk listens globally)
- Collapsed mode: hide completely — ⌘K still works via keyboard globally

**Strip all `bg-white/*` and `border-white/*`** inside AppSidebar. Use the new tokens + existing `--sidebar-*` tokens.

### Admin sidebar (inside AdminLayout.tsx)
Same visual system as user sidebar. Keep the 4 existing groups (Overview / Users & Data / Platform / System) — already good.

**Footer card**: instead of scan usage, show:
- Label: `Admin mode` (small, muted)
- Full-width "Back to App" button (proper contrast, NOT `text-sidebar-foreground/50`)
- Collapsed: icon-only pill with tooltip "Back to App"

Same active/hover tokens. Same ⌘K hint row. Same white-opacity purge.

### sidebar.tsx SidebarTrigger
Make the outer hit area 44×44 on mobile only. Visual icon stays 28×28 (`h-7 w-7`). Use pseudo-element overlay:

```tsx
<Button
  className={cn(
    "h-7 w-7 relative",
    "after:absolute after:-inset-[0.55rem] after:md:hidden after:content-['']",
    className
  )}
  ...
>
```

The `-inset-[0.55rem]` expands the hit box to ~44×44 while the button itself stays 28×28 visually. Pattern already exists elsewhere in the same file near line 493 — match it.

### Visual details to get right
- Icon size: `h-4 w-4` everywhere (Linear uses 16px)
- Nav item height: 36px expanded (override SidebarMenuButton sizing if needed: `className="h-9"`)
- Group label: `text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sidebar-foreground/50`
- Remove `<Separator>` between nav and footer — the card's border is the separator
- Keep `collapsible="icon"` on the `<Sidebar>` root
- Keep existing visibility filters (feature flags, pro-only gating) — do not change the filter logic, only the rendering

## Token values

Add to `app/globals.css` alongside existing `--sidebar-*` tokens. Use oklch to match project convention.

**Light mode** (inside `:root` or `@theme inline`):
- `--sidebar-item-active-bg: oklch(92% 0.004 250);` (very subtle elevated surface)
- `--sidebar-item-hover-bg: oklch(95% 0.003 250);`

**Dark mode** (inside `.dark { }`):
- `--sidebar-item-active-bg: oklch(22% 0.008 250);` (slightly lighter than sidebar bg)
- `--sidebar-item-hover-bg: oklch(18% 0.006 250);`

Tune if the sidebar base color is different — goal is: active is clearly distinct from idle but not loud. Hover is in between.

## Definition of done

- `pnpm typecheck` exits 0
- `pnpm build` exits 0 (run after `rm -rf .next`)
- `rg "bg-white/|border-white/" components/app/sidebar components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` returns 0 hits
- No `text-2xs` in the plan badge area — should be `text-xs`
- SidebarTrigger has the mobile hit area expansion
- Both sidebars compile and render without console errors
- All existing nav items still present and filtered correctly (feature flags, plan gating)

## Do NOT
- Delete or rename routes
- Change `middleware.ts`, `lib/supabase/*`, `contexts/AuthContext.tsx`
- Modify the top bar (`AppHeader.tsx`) except if `SidebarTrigger` usage needs updating  
- Add dependencies
- Touch tests in `e2e/`
- Touch `next.config.ts`, `railway.json`, `nixpacks.toml`

Report back: file list changed, any deviations from plan (with rationale), typecheck + build output.

1	# Sidebar Rebuild — Linear-exact Aesthetic (user + admin)
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	The current CROBOT sidebars (`AppSidebar` for user, the inline sidebar inside `AdminLayout` for admin) were grouped and tooltipped in a prior pass but still feel cheap. Specifically: the active state uses hardcoded `bg-white/10` with a left-border pill accent that reads as busy, the plan badge in the footer is unreadable (`text-2xs` + `border-white/10` + `text-sidebar-foreground/40`), the upgrade CTA feels disconnected from the scan-usage widget, the group labels are inconsistent (some groups unnamed, some "ANALYZE" / "MANAGE"), the mobile `SidebarTrigger` is 28×28 (below WCAG 44×44), and collapsed-mode icons don't feel deliberate.
6	
7	Goal: rebuild both sidebars to match Linear exactly — no left-border pill, token-driven active background, 4 well-labeled groups, premium footer card, ⌘K hint visible, 44×44 mobile trigger, tight 240px expanded / 56px collapsed widths. Same visual system for both sidebars so the product feels unified.
8	
9	## Current state (from exploration)
10	
11	- `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` (231 lines) — user sidebar, 4 groups with 2 unlabeled
12	- `components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` (319 lines) — admin sidebar inlined, 4 labeled groups
13	- `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — shadcn primitive, collapse width `--sidebar-width-icon: 3.5rem` (56px ✓), tooltip wiring already in place
14	- `app/globals.css` — sidebar tokens already defined (`--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-foreground-active`, `--sidebar-primary`, `--sidebar-accent`, `--sidebar-border`, `--sidebar-ring`)
15	- `components/app/AppHeader.tsx` — uses `SidebarTrigger` on line 105
16	- `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` — already exists, ⌘K globally bound
17	
18	## Approach
19	
20	### Phase 1 — Token additions in `app/globals.css`
21	
22	Add two new sidebar tokens so active state doesn't rely on hardcoded `bg-white/10`:
23	
24	- `--sidebar-item-active-bg` = subtle elevated surface (oklch light + dark variants)
25	- `--sidebar-item-hover-bg` = even subtler surface
26	
27	Existing tokens stay untouched — non-breaking.
28	
29	### Phase 2 — `AppSidebar.tsx` rewrite (user sidebar)
30	
31	1. **4 labeled groups**, every group has a 10px uppercase tracked label (Linear pattern). Current unlabeled groups get names:
32	   - **Workspace** — Dashboard, New Scan
33	   - **Analyze** — My Reports, Score History, Competitors
34	   - **Manage** — Integrations, Monitoring
35	   - **Account** — Refer & Earn, API, Settings
36	
37	2. **Active state**: kill the `before:` left-border pill. Replace with `bg-[--sidebar-item-active-bg]` + `text-[--sidebar-foreground-active]` + icon color shift. Linear-tight.
38	
39	3. **Hover state**: `hover:bg-[--sidebar-item-hover-bg]`. 150ms transition.
40	
41	4. **Footer card** — rebuild as a single bordered card (not separator + floating button):
42	   - Top row: plan name (proper contrast, `text-xs` not `text-2xs`, `text-sidebar-foreground` not `/40`) + scan-count
43	   - Middle: progress bar
44	   - Bottom: Upgrade button (full-width when not on agency plan, hidden otherwise)
45	   - In collapsed mode: single icon-only pill with tooltip showing plan + usage
46	
47	5. **⌘K hint row** below footer card — small muted `Search ⌘K` pill that triggers the command palette on click (reuses existing `CommandPalette`). Collapsed mode: hidden (⌘K still works globally).
48	
49	6. **Remove hardcoded white opacities**: `bg-white/5`, `bg-white/10`, `border-white/10` → token-driven.
50	
51	### Phase 3 — `AdminLayout.tsx` sidebar section rewrite
52	
53	Same visual system as `AppSidebar`:
54	- Same active/hover state via the new tokens
55	- Same footer card pattern — but instead of upgrade CTA, the card shows "Admin mode" label + "Back to App" link as the primary action
56	- Kill the current dim `text-sidebar-foreground/50` "Back to App" — make it a proper button with token-driven contrast
57	- Keep admin groups as they are (Overview / Users & Data / Platform / System) — already good
58	
59	### Phase 4 — `SidebarTrigger` mobile fix
60	
61	File: `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` (`SidebarTrigger` component ~line 219).
62	
63	Change: wrap the 28×28 icon button in an outer 44×44 hit area using the `after:absolute after:-inset-2 after:md:hidden` pattern already used elsewhere in the same file (~line 493). Visual remains 28×28 but tappable area is 44×44 on mobile.
64	
65	### Phase 5 — Visual cleanup pass
66	
67	- Ensure every icon in both sidebars is `h-4 w-4` (Linear uses 16px) — currently mixed between `h-4 w-4` and occasional different sizes
68	- Ensure nav item height is 36px expanded (Linear-tight), not the default shadcn 40px. Override via size prop or className.
69	- Group label: `text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sidebar-foreground/50` — tighten tracking, consistent for every group
70	- Separator between footer card and content: remove — card's border IS the separator
71	
72	### Phase 6 — Verification
73	
74	1. `pnpm typecheck` — clean
75	2. `pnpm build` — clean
76	3. Visual smoke:
77	   - Load `/dashboard` → sidebar renders with 4 labeled groups, active state on Dashboard
78	   - Collapse sidebar → icons-only, hover shows tooltips, footer shrinks to icon
79	   - Resize to mobile → hamburger is 44×44 tappable, drawer opens
80	   - Load `/admin` → admin sidebar matches user sidebar visually
81	   - Toggle dark mode → no `bg-white` flash, all tokens resolve
82	4. Grep check: `rg "bg-white/|border-white/" components/app/sidebar components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` → zero hits
83	
84	## Critical files
85	
86	| File | Change |
87	|---|---|
88	| `app/globals.css` | ADD — 2 new sidebar tokens (active-bg, hover-bg) for light + dark |
89	| `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` | REWRITE — 4 labeled groups, no left-pill, footer card, ⌘K hint, token-driven |
90	| `components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` | REWRITE sidebar block only (lines 140–220 range) — match AppSidebar system |
91	| `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` | EDIT — expand `SidebarTrigger` mobile hit area to 44×44 via `after:-inset-2 after:md:hidden` |
92	
93	## Reusable code (no duplication)
94	
95	- `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` — reuse for ⌘K hint click action, already global-bound
96	- `components/ui/badge.tsx` — plan badge uses `Badge variant="neutral" size="sm"`, not a custom inline
97	- `components/shared/StatusBadge.tsx` — not applicable here, but pattern to follow for dot+label consistency
98	- Existing shadcn `SidebarGroup`, `SidebarGroupLabel`, `SidebarMenuButton`, `SidebarMenuItem` primitives in `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — reuse all
99	
100	## Out of scope
101	
102	- Top bar / `AppHeader` — stays as-is
103	- User dropdown menu — stays as-is (already polished)
104	- Admin top bar breadcrumb — stays as-is
105	- Actual nav items / routes — no additions, no removals, only reorganization under new group labels
106	- Dashboard / other page content — untouched
107	
108	## Rollback
109	
110	Every change is a file edit — `git restore <file>` reverts any single file. Full rollback: `git checkout HEAD -- components/app/sidebar components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx components/ui/sidebar.tsx app/globals.css`.
111

1	# ConvertScan (CROBOT)
2	
3	AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with specific AI-generated suggestions to boost conversions.
4	
5	## Stack
6	- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript strict
7	- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix primitives)
8	- **Backend**: Supabase **cloud** (Auth + Postgres + Edge Functions + Storage) — project ref `ovlreynsgoccjzvczglp`
9	- **AI**: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) for Vision + Text analysis
10	- **Billing**: Dodo Payments (subscriptions)
11	- **Email**: Resend
12	- **Performance**: Google PageSpeed Insights API
13	- **Screenshots**: Puppeteer service on Railway
14	- **Monitoring**: Sentry (@sentry/nextjs)
15	- **Package manager**: pnpm 9.15.4 (Node 20+)
16	
17	## Architecture
18	- Next.js 16 App Router with RSC + Server Actions + route handlers under `app/api/`
19	- Supabase SSR via `@supabase/ssr` — browser client in [lib/supabase/client.ts](lib/supabase/client.ts), server client in [lib/supabase/server.ts](lib/supabase/server.ts)
20	- Session refresh + route protection in root-level [middleware.ts](middleware.ts)
21	- Edge Functions (Deno runtime) in `supabase/functions/` deployed to cloud
22	- Database: Postgres via Supabase cloud with RLS on every table
23	- No local Supabase stack — all work runs against the cloud project
24	
25	## Pricing Tiers (4-tier model)
26	- **Free**: 3 scans/month, basic score, top 3 suggestions
27	- **Starter** ($29/mo): 5 scans, all suggestions, basic PDF
28	- **Growth** ($49/mo): 25 scans, AI rewrites, PDF, monitoring, benchmarks
29	- **Pro** ($99/mo): Unlimited scans, everything in Growth + team workspaces (3 seats), API, integrations
30	- **Agency** ($199/mo): Unlimited scans, white-label, 10 seats, client portal, bulk processing, API
31	
32	## The 7 CRO Pillars
33	1. Value Proposition (18% weight)
34	2. CTA Effectiveness (20% weight)
35	3. Trust Signals (17% weight)
36	4. Visual Hierarchy (12% weight)
37	5. Mobile Experience (13% weight)
38	6. Content & Copy (11% weight)
39	7. Page Performance (9% weight)
40	
41	## Directory Layout
42	```
43	app/                     Next.js App Router
44	  (app)/                 authenticated app route group (dashboard, scan, reports, …)
45	  (auth)/                public auth route group (login, signup, reset)
46	  api/                   route handlers
47	  r/                     public shareable reports
48	  changelog/ pricing/ privacy/ terms/
49	components/
50	  admin/ api/ app/ audit/ auth/ competitors/ dashboard/ integrations/
51	  onboarding/ providers/ scan/ shared/ team/ ui/
52	hooks/                   custom React hooks (use-*.ts)
53	lib/
54	  supabase/              client.ts, server.ts, middleware.ts, types.ts
55	  pdf-generator.ts score-utils.ts constants.ts query-client.ts utils.ts
56	types/                   database.ts, index.ts
57	contexts/                React context providers
58	middleware.ts            Next.js middleware (session refresh + route protection)
59	supabase/
60	  config.toml            cloud-linked (project_id = ovlreynsgoccjzvczglp)
61	  migrations/            14 SQL files, source of truth for schema
62	  functions/             17 edge functions, deployed to cloud
63	```
64	
65	## Key Files
66	- [app/layout.tsx](app/layout.tsx) — root layout, providers, theme
67	- [middleware.ts](middleware.ts) — session refresh + protected route enforcement
68	- [lib/supabase/client.ts](lib/supabase/client.ts) — browser Supabase client
69	- [lib/supabase/server.ts](lib/supabase/server.ts) — server client + `getAuthenticatedUser()` + `createServiceRoleClient()`
70	- [lib/constants.ts](lib/constants.ts) — CRO pillars, weights, plan limits, pricing tiers
71	- [lib/score-utils.ts](lib/score-utils.ts) — scoring algorithm, color mapping
72	- [lib/pdf-generator.ts](lib/pdf-generator.ts) — client-side PDF generation
73	- [types/database.ts](types/database.ts) — Supabase schema types
74	- [supabase/functions/analyze-url/](supabase/functions/analyze-url/) — main scan orchestrator
75	- [supabase/functions/pagespeed/](supabase/functions/pagespeed/) — Google PageSpeed integration
76	- [supabase/functions/dodo-checkout/](supabase/functions/dodo-checkout/), `dodo-portal`, `dodo-webhook` — Dodo Payments
77	- [supabase/functions/send-email/](supabase/functions/send-email/) — Resend email service
78	
79	## Database Tables
80	- `profiles` — user profiles with plan/billing info
81	- `scans` — audit scan records
82	- `scan_results` — per-pillar results with findings JSONB
83	- `integrations` — third-party service connections
84	- `audit_logs` — admin action tracking
85	- `support_tickets` — support system
86	- `feature_flags` — feature toggle system
87	- `system_config` — key/value runtime config (plan limits, pillar weights)
88	- Plus: teams + team_members (011), api_keys (012), copy_rewrites (008), score_history (009), competitor_comparison (010), growth features (013), monitoring (014)
89	
90	## Commands
91	- `pnpm dev` — Next.js dev server on port 3000
92	- `pnpm build` — production build
93	- `pnpm start` — production server
94	- `pnpm typecheck` — `tsc --noEmit`
95	- `pnpm lint` — `eslint app components hooks lib --max-warnings=0`
96	- `supabase db push` — apply migrations to cloud
97	- `supabase functions deploy <name>` — deploy a single edge function
98	- `supabase secrets set KEY=value` — set edge function secrets (cloud)
99	
100	## Environment Variables
101	### App (`.env.local`)
102	- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` — `https://ovlreynsgoccjzvczglp.supabase.co`
103	- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` — anon / publishable key
104	- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` — service role key (server-only, used by route handlers + webhooks)
105	
106	### Edge Function Secrets (set via `supabase secrets set`)
107	- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
108	- `PAGESPEED_API_KEY`
109	- `SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_URL`, `SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_API_KEY`
110	- `DODO_API_KEY`, `DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET`
111	- `DODO_PRODUCT_STARTER_MONTHLY` / `_ANNUAL`
112	- `DODO_PRODUCT_GROWTH_MONTHLY` / `_ANNUAL`
113	- `DODO_PRODUCT_PRO_MONTHLY` / `_ANNUAL`
114	- `DODO_PRODUCT_AGENCY_MONTHLY` / `_ANNUAL`
115	- `RESEND_API_KEY`
116	- `SITE_URL`
117	
118	## Conventions
119	- All UI components use shadcn/ui from `components/ui/`
120	- Toast notifications via `sonner`
121	- React Query (`@tanstack/react-query`) for all server state
122	- Supabase RLS enforces data isolation — no manual auth checks needed in queries
123	- Server actions + route handlers use `createClient()` (session-scoped) or `createServiceRoleClient()` (admin ops only)
124	- Edge functions return JSON with CORS headers
125	- Findings stored as JSONB arrays in `scan_results`
126	- Score colors: green (70+), amber (40-69), red (0-39)
127	- Plan gating: `isPaidPlan(profile.plan)` (starter+), `isGrowthPlus(plan)` (growth+), `isProPlus(plan)` (pro+)
128	- TypeScript strict — no `any`, no `as any`, no `@ts-ignore` without justification
129	
130	## Agent Hub (UI-only feature)
131	- Agent pages use mock data from `lib/mock-data.ts`
132	- The agent engine is a client-side simulation — no real backend calls
133	- Do not replace mock data in agent pages without a real backend implementation to replace it with
134	
135	## Sprint Roadmap
136	Full sprint plan: `~/.claude/plans/wondrous-prancing-crescent.md`
137	
138	| Sprint | Weeks | Focus |
139	|--------|-------|-------|
140	| 1 | 1-2 | Foundation: 4-tier pricing, UI polish, dashboard redesign, onboarding |
141	| 2 | 3-4 | Core: AI copy rewrites, score history, re-scan comparison, finding tracker |
142	| 3 | 5-6 | Premium: Competitor comparison, industry benchmarks, shareable links, PDF enhance |
143	| 4 | 7-8 | Agency: Team workspaces, white-label, bulk URL processing |
144	| 5 | 9-10 | API: REST API, Slack, Chrome extension, webhooks |
145	| 6 | 11-12 | Growth: Email sequences, referral program, notifications, SEO pages |
146	| 7 | 13-14 | Analytics: Score monitoring, GA4 integration, Sentry |
147	| 8 | 15-16 | Launch: Performance, accessibility, security, Product Hunt prep |
148
